issues.what: Systemic: a keyframe_review entry without from/to takes the years of its Cliopatria row, and the compiler unions every keyframe active in a year, so an old broad keyframe whose own note says 'valid X-Y only' stays in the union beside the narrower keyframes that follow it. Ghaznavids: 1152 shape kept to 1176, so about 3,100 Afghan and Baluchi cells stayed Ghaznavid in 1161-1176 (-41,766 cell-years after the fix); the 1162 and 1177 keyframe snaps (2,616 and 2,673 cells) disappear

Almoravid 1139 shape (with Oran-Tlemcen and southern Morocco, about 3,200 cells) ran to 1151 beside the single-year keyframes 1144-1148; note says 'Valid 1139-1143'. Almoravid-Almohad conflicts fall from 4,412 to 600 cell-years; the 1152 snap (-749) is gone

Liao: the undivided 1111 shape ran to 1125 beside the Jin-conquest keyframes (note: 'holds 1111-1114'); Jin/Liao size-rule conflicts fall from 1,494 to 34 cell-years and the 1124 snap disappears (Sixteen Prefectures show as Song in 1124)

Liao dissolve (1125) handed the whole Mongolian steppe, the Gobi and western Inner Mongolia to the Jin for a year (3,991 cells) and the 1126 Jin keyframe took them back: the largest keyframe snap of the window. The Jin ruled the Liao lands of Manchuria and the frontier, not the steppe; the land is nobody's from the Liao end

Ghost land in south-east Spain: the Taifa of Murcia loss of 1172 (the whole 1169 outline) is applied by the compiler only as the narrower paired Almohad gains (Murcia, Valencia), so 100 cells (Albacete, Almeria and the lands between) stayed with Murcia from 1172 to 1228. An Almohad gain over the rest of the outline carries them (also changes the end anchor by about 100 cells)
Chernigov kept the Murom-Ryazan lands to 1199 (old 1094 keyframe, note: 'for 1094-1126'); Chernigov -37 cells, Rostov-Suzdal +36 from 1127; the Chernigov/Ryazan conflict disappears
Polotsk kept its undivided 1085 outline (with Latgale and Vilnius) after Vseslav's death in 1101: -1,114 cell-years

Polonnaruwa held the whole island in 1111-1152 and 1197-1199 because the 1072 whole-island shape stayed in the union with the Rajarata keyframes (-150 cells a year, -6,750 cell-years; the 1111 and 1197 snaps disappear). Also changes the end anchor by 150 cells
Hungary kept the pre-1164 Dalmatian and Syrmian cells after the Byzantine occupation (1164-1165) until 1168-1180 (-368 cell-years; Byzantines +92)
Western Chalukya kept Vengi after the Chola recapture of 1133 (-85 cell-years; Chola/Western Chalukya conflicts -109)
Holy Roman Empire 1188 shape (with Bohemia and Moravia) stayed in the union with the 1198 keyframe, after Bohemia became a kingdom in 1198 (conflict with the Margraviate of Moravia -63 cell-years)

dossier_requests.what: Give every keyframe_review entry whose note says 'valid X-Y only' explicit from/to. Unpatched ones in 1100-1199 (set to = value in brackets): paramara-dynasty_1111 (1135), eastern-kara-khanids_1126 (1133), kingdom-of-castile_1152 (1156), duchy-of-masovia_1147 (1162) and _1169 (1172), kingdom-of-aragon_1126 (1126), danishmendids_1169 (1173), county-of-edessa_1139 (1144), county-of-flanders_1188 (1190), holy-roman-empire_1152 (1156) and _1177 (1184), kamarupa-kingdom_1072 (1099), eastern-ganga-kingdom_1056 (1101), fatimid-caliphate_1099 (1103), _1111 (1123), _1152 (1152). The other windows have the same pattern: do_keyframe in tools/compile_dossiers.py unions all keyframes active in a year, and a keyframe without from/to takes its shape's years from data/shapes.csv
dossier_requests.why: Overlapping keyframes: 147 overlapping keyframe pairs in 1100-1199 by a script, 36 of them an old shape that contains the narrower one that follows; the 9 with most effect are patched (about 72,000 cell-years moved with the two events)

problems: Systemic (all windows): loss events whose counterpart has a paired gain in the same year are applied only as that gain (compile_dossiers.py do_event, paired_gain), so a loss region wider than the gain region leaves cells with the loser. Found here (cells left): western-chalukya-empire/ledger/31 to yadava-dynasty 1187 (1,987; the Yadava keyframe covers it), almoravid-dynasty/ledger/40 1147 southern Morocco (732, gone with the Almoravid keyframe fix), duchy-of-greater-poland/ledger/2 and /10 to duchy-of-sandomierz 1177 and 1199 (292 each), kingdom-of-france/ledger/12 to angevin-empire 1152 (205), kingdom-of-castile/ledger/30 to kingdom-of-galicia 1111 (160), almoravid-dynasty/ledger/37 and /31 (145, 138), danishmendids/ledger/7 and /6 (130, 106), western-karakhanid-khanate/ledger/5 (97). Only the Murcia case was patched.

The patch changes the end anchor p1200 by about 287 cells beyond the 5 that other windows' patches change: Taifa of Murcia 100 cells to the Almohads, Polonnaruwa 150 cells (1197-1199 keyframe) to nobody, Chernigov to Rostov-Suzdal 37. The p1200-p1299 window starts from them.

keyframe_overrides/1, /4 and /5 replace dossier keyframes that start before 1100 (principality-of-chernigov_1094, principality-of-polotsky_1085, kingdom-of-polonnaruwa_1072); only their years 1100 and after change, and p1000-p1099.json has no entry for them.
ayyubid-sultanate ledger/9 dates the capture of Aleppo to May 1182, zengid-dynasty ledger/25 dates its hand-over to 12 June 1183; not checked (page budget used).
No hierarchy row was found wrong in the images; the hierarchy rows were not checked against pages.
Trial result: conflicts 56,444 -> 48,791 cell-years, size-rule conflicts 25,450 -> 24,118, keyframe snaps 248 -> 239 (baseline with an empty patch: 245 snaps, 56,485 cell-years).
